name: smartuse
description: Use Claude Code smartly: one line in, a planner-grade kickoff out; feature docs updated from the diff when Claude calls living-docs after a commit it makes, or when you run /smartuse:living-docs; a reply voice you choose; a deterministic safety floor; an until-done Stop gate for the run-plan loop; a receipt for every run and every plan step; and a heartbeat that says whether Claude is working, waiting on an agent, waiting on you, or stalled. Skills: make-prompt · run-plan · living-docs · reply-style · ledger · receipts · status. Hooks: bash-guard · file-guard · ledger · until-done (Stop gate) · heartbeat.
